95ZStatus
96ZRawMasterFile::initJournaling (uriString &pJournalPath)
97{
98ZStatus wSt;
99bool wasOpen=true;
100zmode_type wFormerMode=ZRF_Nothing;
101// this does not touch integrity of files
102
103 if (!_isOpen)
104 {
105
106 wasOpen=false;
107 wSt = zopen(ZRF_Exclusive|ZRF_Write);
108 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
109 {return wSt;}// Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
110 }
111 else
112 {
113 if (Mode!=(ZRF_Exclusive|ZRF_Write))
114 {
115 wFormerMode = Mode;
116 zclose();
117 zopen(ZRF_Exclusive|ZRF_Write);
118 }
119
120 }// else
121
122
123 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
124 fprintf (stderr,
125 "setJournalingOn-I Starting journaling for file %s\n",
126 getURIContent().toString());
127 if (ZJCB==nullptr)
128 {
129 ZJCB = new ZJournalControlBlock;
130 ZJCB->Journal = new ZSJournal(this);
131 }
132 else
133 {
134 if (ZJCB!=nullptr)
135 {
136 fprintf (stderr,
137 "setJournalingOn-W Warning Cannot start journaling for file %s : already started.\n",
138 getURIContent().toString());
139 if (ZJCB->Journal->isOpen())
140 {
141 fprintf (stderr,
142 "setJournalingOn-W Warning journal file %s is already open.\n",
143 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString());
144 return ZS_SUCCESS;
145 }
146 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
147 ZS_FILENOTOPEN,
148 Severity_Severe,
149 " Journaling for file %s is set to started while journal file is marked as not open.",
150 getURIContent().toString());
151 ZException.exit_abort();
152// return ZS_FILENOTOPEN;
153 }
154 } // else
155 wSt=ZJCB->Journal->init();
156 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
157 {
158 ZException.addToLast("While initializing journaling");
159 return wSt;
160 }
161
162// JournalingOn=true;
163 ZJCB->JournalLocalDirectoryPath = pJournalPath;
164 wSt=writeControlBlocks();
165
166 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
167 {
168 return wSt; // Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
169 }
170 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
171 _DBGPRINT("setJournalingOn-I-JCB Journaling set on within JournalingControlBlock\n")
172
173 if (!wasOpen) // if was not open at routine entrance, then it has been openned locally and must be closed
174 {return zclose();}
175
176 if (wFormerMode!=ZRF_Nothing) // if was open but not in appropriate mode
177 {
178 zclose(); // close it
179 wSt=zopen(wFormerMode); // re-open with former mode
180 }
181 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
182 _DBGPRINT("setJournalingOn-I- starting journaling. journaling file %s \n",
183 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString())
184 wSt=ZJCB->Journal->start();
185 if (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS)
186 {
187 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
188 _DBGPRINT(
189 "setJournalingOn-I- Journaling active with journaling file %s \n",
190 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString())
191 }
192 else
193 {
194 ZException.addToLast("While starting journaling thread for journaling file %s",
195 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString());
196 ZException.printUserMessage(stderr);
197
198 }// else
199 return wSt;
200} // initJournaling

202ZStatus
203ZRawMasterFile::setJournalingOn (void)
204{
205ZStatus wSt;
206
207if (!_isOpen)
208 {
209 fprintf (stderr,
210 "setJournalingOn-E File <%s> must be open to start/restart journaling.\n",
211 getURIContent().toString());
212 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
213 ZS_INVOP,
214 Severity_Error,
215 "File <%s> must be open to start/restart journaling.",
216 getURIContent().toString());
217 return ZS_INVOP;
218 }
219
220 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
221 _DBGPRINT(
222 "setJournalingOn-I Starting/restarting journaling on for file %s\n",
223 getURIContent().toString())
224 if (ZJCB->Journal==nullptr) {
225 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
226 _DBGPRINT(
227 "setJournalingOn-E Journaling has not be defined for file %s. Cannot start/restart journaling.\n",
228 getURIContent().toString())
229
230 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
231 ZS_INVOP,
232 Severity_Error,
233 "Journaling has not be defined for file %s. Cannot start/restart journaling.",
234 getURIContent().toString());
235 return ZS_INVOP;
236 }
237
238 if (ZJCB->Journal->JThread.getState() > ZTHS_Nothing)
239 {
240 fprintf (stderr,
241 "setJournalingOn-W Warning Cannot start journaling for file %s : journaling already started. Thread id is %ld\n",
242 getURIContent().toString(),
243 ZJCB->Journal->JThread.getId());
244 if (ZJCB->Journal->isOpen())
245 {
246 fprintf (stderr,
247 "setJournalingOn-W Warning journal file %s is already open.\n",
248 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString());
249 return ZS_SUCCESS;
250 }
251 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
252 ZS_FILENOTOPEN,
253 Severity_Severe,
254 " Setting journaling on : Journaling for file %s is started while journal file is marked as not open.",
255 getURIContent().toString());
256 return ZS_FILENOTOPEN;
257 }
258
259 wSt=ZJCB->Journal->init(true); // Journal file must exist
260 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
261 {
262 ZException.addToLast("While initializing journaling");
263 return wSt;
264 }
265
266
267 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
268 _DBGPRINT(
269 "setJournalingOn-I- starting journaling. journaling file %s \n",
270 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString())
271 wSt=ZJCB->Journal->start();
272 if (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS)
273 {
274 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
275 _DBGPRINT(
276 "setJournalingOn-I- Journaling active with journaling file %s \n",
277 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString())
278 }
279 else
280 {
281 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine()) {
282 _DBGPRINT(
283 "setJournalingOn-E-Failure Journaling on file %s has not started.See ZException stack dump (following) to get information\n",
284 ZJCB->Journal->getURIContent().toString())
285 ZException.printUserMessage();
286 }
287 }// else
288
289 return wSt;
290} // setJournalingOn

621ZStatus
622ZRawMasterFile::_getJCBfromReserved(void)
623{
624 ZMCB_Export* wMCBe = (ZMCB_Export*)ZReserved.Data;
625
626 wMCBe->deserialize();
627
628 if (wMCBe->JCBOffset==0) // no journaling
629 {return ZS_SUCCESS;} // Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
630 if (ZJCB==nullptr)
631 {
632 ZJCB=new ZJournalControlBlock;
633 }
634
635 const unsigned char* wPtrIn=ZReserved.Data+wMCBe->JCBOffset;
636
637 return ZJCB->_import(wPtrIn);
638}

721ZStatus
722ZRawMasterFile::zcreateRawIndex ( ZRawIndexFile *&pIndexObjectOut,
723 const utf8VaryingString &pIndexName,
724 uint32_t pkeyguessedsize,
725 ZSort_Type pDuplicates,
726 long & pOutIndexRank,
727 bool pBackup)
728{
729 ZStatus wSt;
730// bool wasOpen=false;
731 long wi;
732 zsize_type wIndexAllocatedSize=0;
733 uriString wIndexURI;
734 uriString wIndexFileDirectoryPath;
735// ZRawIndexFile *wIndexObject=nullptr;
736 long w1=0,w2=0;
737
738
739 pIndexObjectOut=nullptr;
740 pOutIndexRank=-1;
741 if (getOpenMode()!=(ZRF_Exclusive | ZRF_All)) {
742 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::zcreateRawIndex",
743 ZS_MODEINVALID,
744 Severity_Error,
745 " Trying to create index <%s> while file <%s> has invalid open mode <%s> while required <ZRF_Exclusive|ZRF_All>.\n",
746 pIndexName.toCChar(),
747 URIContent.toCChar(),
748 decode_ZRFMode(getMode()));
749 ErrorLog.logZExceptionLast("ZRawMasterFile::zcreateRawIndex");
750 return ZS_MODEINVALID;
751 }
752
753 // check index name ambiguity
754
755 if ((wi=IndexTable.searchCaseIndexByName(pIndexName.toCChar()))>-1)
756 {
757 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
758 ZS_INVNAME,
759 Severity_Error,
760 " Ambiguous index name <%s>. Index name already exist at Index rank <%ld>. Please use zremoveIndex first.\n",
761 pIndexName.toCChar(),
762 wi);
763 wSt= ZS_INVNAME;
764 goto zcreateRawIndexEnd ;
765 }
766
767
768 // instantiation of the ZIndexFile new structure :
769 // it gives a pointer to the actual ICB stored in Index vector
770 //
771 pIndexObjectOut = new ZRawIndexFile(this,pkeyguessedsize,pIndexName,pDuplicates);
772
773 pOutIndexRank=IndexTable.push(pIndexObjectOut); // since here any creation error will induce a desctruction of IndexTableObjects.lastIdx()
774
775 // ---------compute index file name-------------------
776
777 // Define IndexFileDirectoryPath
778 // if mentionned then take it
779 // if not then take the directory from Master File URI
780
781 if (IndexFilePath.isEmpty())
782 {
783 // utfdescString wDInfo;
784 wIndexFileDirectoryPath=getURIContent().getDirectoryPath();
785 }
786 else
787 {
788 wIndexFileDirectoryPath=IndexFilePath;
789 }
790
791 wSt=generateIndexURI( wIndexURI,
792 getURIContent(),
793 wIndexFileDirectoryPath,
794 // IndexTable.lastIdx(),
795 pIndexName);
796 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
797 {return wSt;} // Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
798
799 // compute the allocated size
800 w1 = wIndexAllocatedSize = _Base::getAllocatedBlocks();
801 w2 = IndexTable[pOutIndexRank]->IndexRecordSize();
802
803 if (_Base::getBlockTargetSize()>0)
804 if (_Base::getAllocatedBlocks()>0)
805 wIndexAllocatedSize = _Base::getAllocatedBlocks() * IndexTable[pOutIndexRank]->IndexRecordSize();
806 //
807 // Nota Bene : there is no History and Journaling processing for Index Files
808 //
809 wSt = pIndexObjectOut->zcreateIndexFile(*IndexTable.last(), // pointer to index control block because ZIndexFile stores pointer to Father's ICB
810 wIndexURI,
811 _Base::getAllocatedBlocks(),
812 _Base::getBlockExtentQuota(),
813 wIndexAllocatedSize,
814 _Base::getHighwaterMarking(),
815 // _Base::getGrabFreeSpace(),
816 false, // grabfreespace is set to false
817 pBackup,
818 true // leave it open
819 );
820 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
821 goto zcreateRawIndexError;
822

1255ZRawMasterFile::_createRawIndexDet (long &pOutRank,

1257 uint32_t pkeyguessedsize,

1259 long pAllocatedBlocks, /* ---FCB parameters (for index ZRandomFile)---- */

1261 zsize_type pInitialSize,
1262 bool pHighwaterMarking,
1263 bool pGrabFreeSpace,
1264 bool pReplace,
1265 ZaiErrors* pErrorLog)
1266{
1267 ZStatus wSt;
1268// bool wIsOpen = isOpen();
1269 long wi;
1270 zsize_type wIndexAllocatedSize=0;
1271 uriString wIndexURI;
1272 uriString wIndexFileDirectoryPath;
1273 ZRawIndexFile *wIndexObject=nullptr;
1274 ssize_t wRet=0;
1275 long w1=0,w2=0;
1276
1277 pErrorLog->setContext("_createRawIndexDet");
1278 if (!isOpen())
1279 {
1280 ZException.setMessage (_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
1281 ZS_MODEINVALID,
1282 Severity_Error,
1283 " ZRawMasterFile <%s> must be open.",
1284 getURIContent().toCChar());
1285 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast();
1286 pErrorLog->popContext();
1287 return ZS_MODEINVALID;
1288 }
1289
1290 if (!(getOpenMode()&(ZRF_Exclusive|ZRF_All)))
1291 {
1292 ZException.setMessage (_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
1293 ZS_MODEINVALID,
1294 Severity_Error,
1295 " ZRawMasterFile <%s> must be open with mode <ZRF_Exclusive|ZRF_All>.",
1296 getURIContent().toCChar());
1297 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast();
1298 pErrorLog->popContext();
1299
1300 return ZS_MODEINVALID;
1301 }
1302
1303 // check index name ambiguity
1304
1305 if ((wi=IndexTable.searchCaseIndexByName(pIndexName.toCChar()))>-1)
1306 {
1307 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
1308 ZS_INVNAME,
1309 Severity_Error,
1310 " Ambiguous index name <%s>. Index name already exist at Index rank <%ld>. Please use zremoveIndex first.\n",
1311 pIndexName.toCChar(),
1312 wi);
1313 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast();
1314 wSt= ZS_INVNAME;
1315 goto createRawIndexDet1End ;
1316 }
1317
1318 // instantiation of the ZIndexFile new structure :
1319 // it gives a pointer to the actual ICB stored in Index vector
1320 //
1321 wIndexObject = new ZRawIndexFile(this,pkeyguessedsize,pIndexName,pDuplicates);
1322
1323 pOutRank=IndexTable.push(wIndexObject); // since here any creation error will induce a desctruction of IndexTableObjects.lastIdx()
1324
1325 if (pOutRank < 0)
1326 {
1327 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
1328 ZS_ERROR,
1329 Severity_Error,
1330 "Index name <%s> : Cannot push index object to index table.\n",
1331 pIndexName.toCChar());
1332 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast();
1333 delete wIndexObject;
1334 pErrorLog->popContext();
1335 return ZS_ERROR;
1336 }
1337
1338 // ---------compute index file name-------------------
1339
1340 // Define IndexFileDirectoryPath
1341 // if mentionned then take it
1342 // if not then take the directory from Master File URI
1343
1344 if (IndexFilePath.isEmpty())
1345 {
1346 // utfdescString wDInfo;
1347 wIndexFileDirectoryPath=getURIContent().getDirectoryPath();
1348 }
1349 else
1350 {
1351 wIndexFileDirectoryPath=IndexFilePath;
1352 }
1353
1354 wSt=generateIndexURI( wIndexURI,
1355 getURIContent(),
1356 wIndexFileDirectoryPath,
1357// pOutRank,
1358 pIndexName);
1359 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1360 {goto createRawIndexDet1End;}
1361
1362 // compute the allocated size
1363 w1 = wIndexAllocatedSize = _Base::getAllocatedBlocks();
1364 w2 = IndexTable.last()->IndexRecordSize();
1365
1366 if (_Base::getBlockTargetSize()>0)
1367 if (_Base::getAllocatedBlocks()>0)
1368 wIndexAllocatedSize = _Base::getAllocatedBlocks() * IndexTable[pOutRank]->IndexRecordSize();
1369 //
1370 // Nota Bene : there is no History and Journaling processing for Index Files
1371 //
1372 wSt = wIndexObject->zcreateIndexFile(*IndexTable[pOutRank], // pointer to index control block because ZIndexFile stores pointer to Father's ICB
1373 wIndexURI,
1374 pAllocatedBlocks,
1375 pBlockExtentQuota,
1376 pInitialSize,
1377 pHighwaterMarking,
1378 pGrabFreeSpace, // grabfreespace is set to false
1379 pReplace,
1380 false // do not leave it open
1381 );
1382 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1383 goto createRawIndexDet1Error;
1384
1385 // IndexTable.last()->generateCheckSum();
1386
1387 // update MCB to Reserved block in RandomFile header (_Base)
1388 // then write updated Master Control Block to Master Header
1389 //
1390 wSt= wIndexObject->openIndexFile(wIndexURI,pOutRank,(ZRF_Exclusive | ZRF_All));
1391 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1392 goto createRawIndexDet1Error;
1393/*
1394 wSt=wIndexObject->zrebuildRawIndex(ZMFStatistics ,stderr);
1395 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1396 goto createRawIndexDet1Error;
1397*/
1398createRawIndexDet1End:
1399 /* ICB has changed : force save all control blocks */
1400 ZReserved.clear();
1401 wRet=ZMasterControlBlock::_exportAppend(ZReserved);
1402
1403 wSt=_writeAllFileHeader();
1404
1405 pErrorLog->popContext();
1406 return wSt;
1407
1408createRawIndexDet1Error:
1409 if (IndexTable[pOutRank]->getURIContent().exists()) {
1410 IndexTable[pOutRank]->zclose();
1411 IndexTable[pOutRank]->_removeFile(true,&ErrorLog);
1412 }
1413 IndexTable.erase(pOutRank) ; // destroy the ZIndexFile object
1414 ZException.addToLast(" While creating new raw index <%s> for raw master file <%s>. Index has not been created.",
1415 pIndexName.toCChar(),
1416 URIContent.toCChar());
1417 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast();
1418 pOutRank=-1;
1419 goto createRawIndexDet1End;
1420}//_createRawIndexDetailed

1524 {goto insertRawIndexDet1Error;}
1525
1526 // compute the allocated size
1527 w1 = wIndexAllocatedSize = _Base::getAllocatedBlocks();
1528 w2 = IndexTable.last()->IndexRecordSize();
1529
1530 if (_Base::getBlockTargetSize()>0)
1531 if (_Base::getAllocatedBlocks()>0)
1532 wIndexAllocatedSize = _Base::getAllocatedBlocks() * IndexTable[pInputIndexRank]->IndexRecordSize();
1533 //
1534 // Nota Bene : there is no History and Journaling processing for Index Files
1535 //
1536
1537 /* effective creation of ZRandomFile containing the index- enrich wIndexObject with file's parameters */
1538
1539 wSt = wIndexObject->zcreateIndexFile(*IndexTable[pInputIndexRank], // ZIndexFile inherits from ZRawIndexFile then from ZIndexControlBlock )
1540 wIndexURI,
1541 pAllocatedBlocks,
1542 pBlockExtentQuota,
1543 pInitialSize,
1544 pHighwaterMarking,
1545 pGrabFreeSpace, // grabfreespace is set to false
1546 pReplace,
1547 false // do not leave it open
1548 );
1549 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1550 goto insertRawIndexDet1Error;
1551
1552 // IndexTable.last()->generateCheckSum();
1553
1554 // update MCB to Reserved block in RandomFile header (_Base)
1555 // then write updated Master Control Block to Master Header
1556 //
1557 wSt= wIndexObject->openIndexFile(wIndexURI,pInputIndexRank,(ZRF_Exclusive | ZRF_All));
1558 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1559 goto insertRawIndexDet1End;
1560/*
1561 wSt=wIndexObject->zrebuildRawIndex(ZMFStatistics ,stderr);
1562 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
1563 goto insertRawIndexDet1Error;
1564*/
1565insertRawIndexDet1End:
1566 return wSt;
1567
1568insertRawIndexDet1Error:
1569 IndexTable[pInputIndexRank]->zclose();
1570 IndexTable[pInputIndexRank]->_removeFile(true,&ErrorLog);
1571 IndexTable.erase(pInputIndexRank) ; // destroy the ZIndexFile object
1572 ZException.addToLast(" While creating new raw index <%s> for raw master file <%s>. Index has not been created.",
1573 pIndexName.toCChar(),
1574 URIContent.toCChar());
1575 goto insertRawIndexDet1End;
1576}//_insertRawIndexDetailed

1891 _DBGPRINT("ZRawMasterFile::zremoveAll-I- Removing all content of file <%s>.\n",getURIContent().toString())
1892 _DBGPRINT("ZRawMasterFile::zremoveAll-I- Removing content for indexes.\n")

1896 for (long wi=0; wi < IndexTable.count(); wi++) {
1897 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine()) {

1907 }
1908 }// for
1909 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine()) {
1910 _DBGPRINT("ZRawMasterFile::zremoveAll-I- Removing all content for master file itself.\n")
1911 }
1912 return ZRandomFile::zremoveAll();

1916int
1917ZRawMasterFile::_getAvailableBckNum(const uriString& pBackupPath,const utf8VaryingString &pBckExt){
1918 uriString wBackupPath=pBackupPath;
1919 if (pBackupPath.isEmpty())
1920 wBackupPath = getURIContent().getDirectoryPath();
1921 wBackupPath.addConditionalDirectoryDelimiter();
1922
1923 utf8VaryingString wMasterRootName = getURIContent().getRootname();
1924 utf8VaryingString wMasterBaseName = getURIContent().getBasename();
1925
1926 utf8VaryingString wDicBaseName = getURIDictionary().getBasename();
1927 utf8VaryingString wDicPath = getURIDictionary().getDirectoryPath();
1928 uriString wURI ;
1929 int wBckNumber=1;
1930 if (Dictionary!=nullptr){
1931 wURI.sprintf("%s%s_%s%d", wBackupPath.toString(),wDicBaseName.toString(),pBckExt.toString(),wBckNumber);
1932
1933 while (wURI.exists()) {
1934 wBckNumber++;
1935 wURI.sprintf("%s%s_%s%d", wBackupPath.toString(),wDicBaseName.toString(), pBckExt.toString(),wBckNumber);
1936 } // while
1937 }// if (Dictionary!=nullptr)
1938
1939 while (true) {
1940 while (true) {
1941 wURI.sprintf("%s%s_%s%d",wBackupPath.toString(),wMasterBaseName.toString(),pBckExt.toString(),wBckNumber);
1942 if (wURI.exists())
1943 break;
1944 wURI.sprintf("%s%s_%s%d",wBackupPath.toString(),getURIHeader().getBasename().toString(),pBckExt.toString(),wBckNumber);
1945 if (wURI.exists())
1946 break;
1947 for (long wi=0; wi < IndexTable.count() ; wi++ ) {
1948 utf8VaryingString wIR = generateIndexRootName(wMasterRootName,IndexTable[wi]->IndexName);
1949
1950 wURI.sprintf("%s%s.%s_%s%d",wBackupPath.toString(),wIR.toString(),__ZINDEX_FILEEXTENSION__,pBckExt.toString(),wBckNumber);
1951 if (wURI.exists())
1952 break;
1953 wURI.sprintf("%s%s.%s_%s%d",wBackupPath.toString(),wIR.toString(),__HEADER_FILEEXTENSION__,pBckExt.toString(),wBckNumber);
1954 if (wURI.exists())
1955 break;
1956 }
1957 /* no file with that wFormerNumber already exist */
1958 return wBckNumber;
1959 } // while true
1960 wBckNumber++;
1961 }// while true
1962} //_getAvailableBckNum

1965ZStatus
1966ZRawMasterFile::extractBasenameBack(const uriString& pBckFile,utf8VaryingString& pBasename,utf8VaryingString& pBckExt,int &pNum){
1967
1968 utf8VaryingString wBasename=pBckFile.getBasename();
1969
1970 utf8_t* wPtr=wBasename.Data;
1971
1972 /* get till the end of full name string */
1973 while (*wPtr){
1974 wPtr++;
1975 }
1976
1977 utf8_t* wPtrEnd = wPtr;
1978
1979 /* capture initial base name (root name + extension) */
1980
1981 while (wPtr > wBasename.Data) {
1982 if (*wPtr == '_') {
1983 break;
1984 }
1985 if (*wPtr == '.')
1986 break;
1987 wPtr--;
1988 }
1989 if (wPtr==wBasename.Data)
1990 return ZS_INVNAME;
1991 if (*wPtr == '.') { /* not a bck extension */
1992 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::extractBasenameBack",ZS_INVTYPE,Severity_Error,"%s is not a backup file. Cannot find a valid bck extension (missing \'_\' character).",pBckFile.toString());
1993 return ZS_INVTYPE;
1994 }
1995
1996 *wPtr=0;
1997 pBasename = wBasename;
1998 /* capture 2 last digits */
1999
2000 pNum=0;
2001 int wPow = 1 ;
2002 bool wHasDigit=false;
2003 while (wPtrEnd > wPtr) {
2004 if ((*wPtrEnd < '0') || (*wPtrEnd > '9'))
2005 break;
2006 pNum += (int(*wPtrEnd)-int('0')) * wPow ;
2007 wPow *= 10 ;
2008 wHasDigit = true;
2009 wPtrEnd--;
2010 } // while
2011
2012 if (!wHasDigit) { /* not a bck extension */
2013 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::extractBasenameBack",ZS_INVTYPE,Severity_Error,"%s is not a backup file. Cannot find a valid bck extension (missing trailing 2 digits).",pBckFile.toString());
2014 return ZS_INVTYPE;
2015 }
2016
2017 /* capture bck extension : characters between wPtr and wPtrEnd */
2018
2019 wPtrEnd++;
2020 *wPtrEnd = 0;
2021
2022 wPtr++; /* skip 0 mark */
2023
2024 pBckExt = wPtr;
2025 return ZS_SUCCESS ;
2026}// extractRootBack

2178 /* master content file */
2179 wElt.Source = getURIContent();
2180
2181 wStat=wElt.Source.getStatR();
2182 wElt.Created = wStat.Created;
2183 wElt.LastModified = wStat.LastModified;
2184
2185 wSize += wElt.Size = wStat.Size ;
2186
2187 wElt.Target = getURIContent().getBasename();
2188 pFileList.push(wElt) ;
2189
2190 /* master header file */
2191 wElt.Source = getURIHeader();
2192
2193 wStat=wElt.Source.getStatR();
2194 wElt.Created = wStat.Created;
2195 wElt.LastModified = wStat.LastModified;
2196
2197 wSize += wElt.Size = wStat.Size ;
2198
2199 wElt.Target = getURIHeader().getBasename();
2200
2201 // wElt.Target = wTargetDir;
2202 // wElt.Target += MasterFile.getURIHeader().getBasename();
2203 pFileList.push(wElt) ;
2204
2205 /* dictionary file if any */
2206 if (Dictionary!=nullptr) {
2207 wElt.Source = Dictionary->URIDictionary ;
2208
2209 wStat=wElt.Source.getStatR();
2210 wElt.Created = wStat.Created;
2211 wElt.LastModified = wStat.LastModified;
2212
2213 wSize += wElt.Size = wStat.Size ;
2214
2215 wElt.Target = Dictionary->URIDictionary.getBasename();
2216 pFileList.push(wElt);
2217 }
2218
2219 for (long wi=0; wi < IndexTable.count(); wi++) {
2220
2221 wElt.Source = IndexTable[wi]->getURIContent() ;
2222 wElt.Size = wElt.Source.getFileSize();
2223
2224 wStat=wElt.Source.getStatR();
2225 wElt.Created = wStat.Created;
2226 wElt.LastModified = wStat.LastModified;
2227
2228 wSize += wElt.Size = wStat.Size ;
2229
2230 wElt.Target = IndexTable[wi]->getURIContent().getBasename();
2231 pFileList.push(wElt);
2232
2233 wElt.Source = IndexTable[wi]->getURIHeader() ;
2234 wElt.Size = wElt.Source.getFileSize();
2235
2236 wStat=wElt.Source.getStatR();
2237
2238 wElt.Created = wStat.Created;
2239 wElt.LastModified = wStat.LastModified;
2240 wSize += wElt.Size = wStat.Size ;
2241
2242 wElt.Target = IndexTable[wi]->getURIHeader().getBasename();

2249ZRawMasterFile::XmlSaveBackupset(uriString& pXmlFile,ZArray<BckElement>& pFileList, bool pComment) {
2250 utf8VaryingString wReturn = fmtXMLdeclaration();
2251 int wLevel=0;
2252 wReturn += fmtXMLnodeWithAttributes("zbackupset","version",__ZRF_XMLVERSION_CONTROL__,0);
2253
2254 wReturn+=fmtXMLdatefull("date",ZDateFull::currentDateTime(),wLevel);
2255
2256 wReturn += fmtXMLnode("filelist",wLevel);
2257 wLevel++;
2258
2259 for (long wi=0; wi < pFileList.count();wi++) {
2260 wReturn += fmtXMLnode("file",wLevel);
2261 wLevel++;
2262 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("source",pFileList[wi].Source.toString(),wLevel);
2263 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("target",pFileList[wi].Target.toString(),wLevel);
2264 wReturn+=fmtXMLulong("size",pFileList[wi].Size,wLevel);
2265 wReturn+=fmtXMLZStatus("status",pFileList[wi].Status,wLevel);
2266 wReturn+=fmtXMLdatefull("creationdate",pFileList[wi].Created,wLevel);
2267 wReturn+=fmtXMLdatefull("modificationdate",pFileList[wi].LastModified,wLevel);
2268 wLevel--;
2269 wReturn += fmtXMLendnode("file",wLevel);
2270 }
2271
2272 wLevel--;
2273 wReturn += fmtXMLendnode("filelist",wLevel);
2274 wLevel--;
2275
2276 wReturn += fmtXMLendnode("zbackupset",0);
2277
2278 return pXmlFile.writeContent(wReturn);
2279}

2281ZStatus
2282ZRawMasterFile::XmlLoadBackupset(const uriString& pXmlFile,ZArray<BckElement>& pFileList,ZDateFull& pBackupDate)
2283{
2284 ZStatus wSt;
2285
2286 utf8VaryingString wXmlContent;
2287
2288 zxmlDoc *wDoc = nullptr;
2289 zxmlElement *wRoot = nullptr;
2290 zxmlElement *wFileRootNode=nullptr;
2291 zxmlElement *wSingleFileNode=nullptr;
2292 zxmlElement *wSwapNode=nullptr;
2293
2294 wSt = pXmlFile.loadUtf8(wXmlContent);
2295 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2296 ZException.prependToLast("Problem while loading backup set xml description file <%s> \n",pXmlFile.toString());
2297 return wSt;
2298 }
2299
2300 wDoc = new zxmlDoc;
2301 wSt = wDoc->ParseXMLDocFromMemory(wXmlContent.toCChar(), wXmlContent.getUnitCount(), nullptr, 0);
2302 if (wSt != ZS_SUCCESS) {
2303 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::XmlLoadBackupset",wSt,Severity_Error,"Xml parsing error for xml document <%s>",
2304 wXmlContent.subString(0, 25).toUtf());
2305 return wSt;
2306 }
2307 wSt = wDoc->getRootElement(wRoot);
2308 if (wSt != ZS_SUCCESS) {
2309 return wSt;
2310 }
2311 if (!(wRoot->getName() == "zbackupset")) {
2312 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::XmlLoadBackupset",ZS_XMLINVROOTNAME,Severity_Error,
2313 "Invalid root node name <%s> expected <zbackupset>",
2314 wRoot->getName().toCChar());
2315 return ZS_XMLINVROOTNAME;
2316 }
2317
2318 wSt=XMLgetChildZDateFull(wSingleFileNode,"date",pBackupDate);
2319
2320 wSt=wRoot->getChildByName((zxmlNode*&)wFileRootNode,"filelist");
2321 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2322 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::XmlLoadBackupset",ZS_XMLMISSREQ,Severity_Error,
2323 "Cannot find node name <filelist>");
2324 return ZS_XMLMISSREQ;
2325 }
2326
2327 wSt=wFileRootNode->getFirstChild((zxmlNode*&)wSingleFileNode);
2328 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2329 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::XmlLoadBackupset",ZS_XMLCORRUPTED,Severity_Error,
2330 "Cannot find child node name under node <filelist>. Xml document is incomplete or corrupted.");
2331 return ZS_XMLCORRUPTED;
2332 }
2333 if (wSingleFileNode->getName()!="file") {
2334 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::XmlLoadBackupset",ZS_XMLINVNODENAME,Severity_Error,
2335 "Got node name <%s> while expecting node <file>",wSingleFileNode->getName().toString());
2336 return ZS_XMLINVNODENAME;
2337 }
2338
2339 pFileList.clear(); /* clear files definitions */
2340 while (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS)
2341 {
2342 BckElement wElt;
2343 wSt=XMLgetChildText(wSingleFileNode,"source",wElt.Source);
2344 wSt=XMLgetChildText(wSingleFileNode,"target",wElt.Target);
2345 wSt=XMLgetChildULong(wSingleFileNode,"size",wElt.Size);
2346 wSt=XMLgetChildZStatus(wSingleFileNode,"status",(int64_t&)wElt.Status);
2347 wSt=XMLgetChildZDateFull(wSingleFileNode,"creationdate",wElt.Created);
2348 wSt=XMLgetChildZDateFull(wSingleFileNode,"modificationdate",wElt.LastModified);
2349
2350 wSt=wSingleFileNode->getNextNode((zxmlNode*&)wSwapNode);
2351 XMLderegister(wSingleFileNode);
2352 wSingleFileNode=wSwapNode;
2353 } // while
2354
2355 XMLderegister(wSingleFileNode);
2356 XMLderegister(wFileRootNode);
2357 XMLderegister(wRoot);
2358
2359 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2360} // ZMFBckDLg::XmlLoadBackupset

2643ZStatus
2644ZRawMasterFile::zopen (const uriString &pURI, const int pMode)
2645{
2646ZStatus wSt;
2647
2648const unsigned char*wPtrIn = nullptr;
2649
2650 if (pURI.isEmpty())
2651 {
2652 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::zopen ",
2653 ZS_INVNAME,
2654 Severity_Error,
2655 "Invalid file name <empty>.");
2656 return ZS_INVNAME;
2657 }
2658 wSt=ZRandomFile::setPath(pURI);
2659 wSt=ZRandomFile::_ZRFopen (pMode,ZHeader.FileType);/* opens and get all headers including Reserved header : ZReserved */
2660 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2661 return wSt;
2662
2663 wPtrIn=ZReserved.Data;
2664
2665 wSt=ZMasterControlBlock::_import(wPtrIn); /* beware wPtrIn is modified by _import */
2666
2667 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2668 {return wSt;}// Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
2669
2670// MCB is loaded
2671//----------Journaling----------------------
2672
2673// if (JournalingOn)
2674 if (hasJournal()) { // if journaling requested
2675 if (ZJCB->Journal==nullptr) // if no journaling : create one
2676 {
2677 ZJCB->Journal=new ZSJournal(this);
2678 wSt=ZJCB->Journal->init();
2679 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2680 {return wSt;}// Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
2681// ZJCB->Journal->start();
2682 }
2683 else
2684 {
2685 if (!ZJCB->Journal->isOpen()) // if journal file is closed then need to re-open and restart
2686 {
2687 if (ZJCB->Journal->JThread.isCreated()) // journal file is not open but journaling thread is active
2688 {
2689 ZJCB->Journal->JThread.kill();
2690 }
2691 }
2692 }
2693 /* const unsigned char* wPtrIn=ZReserved.Data+JCBOffset;
2694
2695 ZJCB->_import(wPtrIn);
2696*/
2697 ZJCB->Journal->init();
2698 ZJCB->Journal->start();
2699 } // JournalingOn
2700
2701
2702//--------------End journaling----------------------------
2703
2704// Index table has been created during import operation.
2705// Each index object must be opened has an index file
2706// IndexTable.clear();
2707 uriString wIndexUri;
2708long wi;
2709
2710 for (wi=0;wi < IndexTable.size();wi++)
2711 {
2712// ZIndexFile* wIndex = new ZIndexFile (this,(ZSIndexControlBlock&) *IndexTable[wi]);
2713// IndexTable.push(wIndex);
2714 wIndexUri.clear();
2715
2716 wSt=generateIndexURI(wIndexUri,pURI,IndexFilePath,IndexTable[wi]->IndexName);
2717 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2718 {
2719 return wSt;// Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
2720 }
2721 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
2722 _DBGPRINT("Opening Index file <%s>\n",(const char*)wIndexUri.toString())
2723
2724 wSt=IndexTable[wi]->openIndexFile(wIndexUri,wi,pMode);
2725 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2726 {
2727 ZException.addToLast("\n while opening index rank <%ld>", wi);
2728// In case of open index error : close any already opened index file
2729// Then close master content file before return ing
2730 ZStatus wSvSt = wSt;
2731 long wj;
2732 for (wj = 0;wj < wi;wj++) {
2733 IndexTable[wj]->zclose(); // use the base ZRandomFile zclose routine
2734 } // for
2735 _Base::zclose();
2736
2737 return wSt;
2738 }
2739 }// for
2740
2741
2742 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2743}// zopen

2747ZRawMasterFile::zopenIndexFile(long pRank,const int pMode) {

2758

2766ZStatus
2767ZRawMasterFile::zclose(void)
2768{
2769ZStatus wSt;
2770ZStatus SavedSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
2771ZDataBuffer wMCBContent;
2772
2773// closing index files
2774
2775 if (!_isOpen) {
2776 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
2777 ZS_INVOP,
2778 Severity_Error,
2779 " file is not open : cannot close it.");
2780 return ZS_INVOP;
2781 }
2782 for (long wi=0;wi < IndexTable.size();wi++)
2783 {
2784 if ((wSt=IndexTable[wi]->closeIndexFile())!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2785 {
2786 ZException.printUserMessage(stderr); // error on close is not blocking because we need to close ALL files
2787 SavedSt = wSt;
2788 }
2789 }// for
2790
2791// flush MCB to file
2792 size_t wRet=_exportAppend(wMCBContent);
2793 setReservedContent(wMCBContent);
2794
2795/* Following is not necessary : zclose does the job
2796 *
2797 wSt=ZRandomFile::updateReservedBlock(wMCBContent,true);// force to write
2798
2799 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2800 ZException.addToLast( "\nWriting Reserved header for ZRawMasterFile %s",
2801 getURIContent().toString());
2802 ZRandomFile::_forceClose();
2803 return wSt;
2804 }
2805*/
2806// releasing index resources
2807
2808 while (IndexTable.size()>0) {
2809 IndexTable.pop();
2810 }
2811// ending journaling process
2812
2813// setJournalingOff(); // nope
2814
2815// closing main ZMF content file
2816
2817 wSt=ZRandomFile::zclose(); /* zclose writes file header blocks (HCB, MCB FCB) */
2818 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2819 {
2820 return wSt;// Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
2821 }
2822/* if (SavedSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2823 { return SavedSt;}// Beware return is multiple instructions in debug mode
2824*/
2825 ZReserved.clear();
2826 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2827}// zclose

2865
2866ZStatus ZRawMasterFile::_renameBck(const uriString &pContentPath,
2867 ZaiErrors *pErrorLog,
2868 bool pNoExcept,
2869 const char *pBckExt)
2870{
2871 ZStatus wRetSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
2872 uriString wNewURI;
2873 if (isOpen())
2874 zclose();
2875 ZStatus wSt=zopen(pContentPath,ZRF_Exclusive);
2876 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2877 {
2878 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
2879 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast();
2880 zclose();
2881 return wSt;
2882 }
2883
2884 int wBckNumber = _testBckNumber(1,pBckExt);
2885 for (long wi=0;wi < IndexTable.size();wi++)
2886 {
2887 wBckNumber=IndexTable[wi]->_testBckNumber(wBckNumber,pBckExt);
2888 }// for
2889 if (hasDictionary()) {
2890 uriString wDic = getURIDictionary();
2891 do {
2892 wDic = getURIDictionary();
2893 wDic.addsprintf("_%s%02d",pBckExt,wBckNumber);
2894 wBckNumber ++;
2895 } while ((wDic.exists()));
2896 }
2897
2898 wNewURI=URIContent;
2899 wNewURI.addsprintf("_%s%02d",pBckExt,wBckNumber);
2900 wSt=rawRename(URIContent,wNewURI,pNoExcept,pErrorLog);
2901
2902 wNewURI=URIHeader;
2903 wNewURI.addsprintf("_%s%02d",pBckExt,wBckNumber);
2904 wSt=rawRename(URIHeader,wNewURI,pNoExcept,pErrorLog);
2905
2906
2907
2908 for (long wi=0;wi < IndexTable.size();wi++) {
2909 wNewURI=IndexTable[wi]->URIContent;
2910 wNewURI.addsprintf("_%s%02d",pBckExt,wBckNumber);
2911 wSt=rawRename(URIContent,wNewURI,pNoExcept,pErrorLog);
2912
2913 wNewURI=IndexTable[wi]->URIHeader;
2914 wNewURI.addsprintf("_%s%02d",pBckExt,wBckNumber);
2915 wSt=rawRename(URIHeader,wNewURI,pNoExcept,pErrorLog);
2916 }// for
2917
2918 if (hasDictionary()) {
2919 wNewURI=getURIDictionary();
2920 wNewURI.addsprintf("_%s%02d",pBckExt,wBckNumber);
2921 wSt=rawRename(getURIDictionary(),wNewURI,pNoExcept,pErrorLog);
2922 }
2923
2924 return wSt;
2925}//_renameBck

3027#ifdef __OLD_VERSION__
3028
3029ZStatus
3030ZRawMasterFile::_insertRaw (ZRawRecord *pRecord, const zrank_type pZMFRank)
3031{
3032 ZStatus wSt;
3033
3034 zrank_type wZMFIdxCommit;
3035 zaddress_type wZMFAddress=0;
3036
3037 ZArray <zrank_type> IndexRankProcessed; // stores ranks of already processed indexes (rollback purpose)
3038 ZIndexItemList IndexItemList; // stores keys description per index processed
3039
3040 ZIndexItem* wIndexItem;
3041 zrank_type wIndex_Rank;
3042
3043 /* prepare the add on Master File, reserve appropriate space, get entry in pool.
3044 * NB: wZMFIdxCommit must be equal to requested rank (pRecord->Rank) in case of success or -1 if fails.
3045 */
3046
3047 pRecord->Rank = pZMFRank;
3048 wZMFIdxCommit=pRecord->Rank ;
3049 wSt=_Base::_insert2Phases_Prepare(pRecord->RawContent,wZMFIdxCommit,pRecord->Address);
3050 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3051 goto _insertRaw_error;
3052
3053 //
3054 // update all Indexes
3055 //
3056
3057 for (wIndex_Rank=0;wIndex_Rank< IndexTable.size();wIndex_Rank++)
3058 {
3059 wIndexItem = new ZIndexItem;
3060 wIndexItem->Operation=ZO_Insert;
3061
3062 wSt=IndexTable[wIndex_Rank]->_extractRawKey(pRecord,wIndexItem->KeyContent);
3063 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3064 {
3065 ZException.addToLast("During _extractRawKey operation on index number <%ld>",wIndex_Rank);
3066 delete wIndexItem;
3067 // on error Soft rollback all already processed indexes in their original state (IndexRankProcessed heap contains the Index ranks added to Indexes that have been processed)
3068 _add_RollbackIndexes (IndexRankProcessed); // An additional error during index rollback will pushed on exception stack
3069 // on error reset ZMF in its original state
3070 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(wZMFIdxCommit); // do not accept update on Master File and free resources
3071 goto _insertRaw_error;
3072 }
3073
3074 wSt=IndexTable[wIndex_Rank]->_addRawKeyValue_Prepare(wIndexItem,wZMFIdxCommit, wZMFAddress);// for indexes don't care about insert, this is an add key value
3075 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3076 {
3077 ZException.addToLast("During zinsert operation on index number <%ld>",wIndex_Rank);
3078 delete wIndexItem;
3079 // on error Soft rollback all already processed indexes in their original state (IndexRankProcessed heap contains the Index ranks added to Indexes that have been processed)
3080 _add_RollbackIndexes ( IndexRankProcessed); // An additional error during index rollback will pushed on exception stack
3081 // on error reset ZMF in its original state
3082 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(wZMFIdxCommit); // do not accept update on Master File and free resources
3083 goto _insertRaw_error;
3084 }
3085
3086 IndexRankProcessed.push(wIndex_Rank) ; // this index has been added to this rank
3087 IndexItemList.push(wIndexItem); // with that key content
3088
3089 // ZMFJournaling.push (ZO_Add,wi,pRecord,wAddress);
3090 }// main for
3091
3092 // so far everything when well
3093 // commit Indexes changes
3094 // if an error occurs during index commit :
3095 // indexes are rolled back (soft or hard) appropriately within _add_CommitIndexes
3096 // Nb: Exception(s) is(are) pushed on stack
3097 wSt=_add_CommitIndexes (IndexItemList,IndexRankProcessed) ;
3098 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3099 {
3100 // Soft rollback master update regardless returned ZStatus
3101 // Nb: Exception is pushed on stack. ZException keeps the last status.
3102 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(wZMFIdxCommit);
3103
3104 goto _insertRaw_error;
3105 }
3106
3107 // at this stage all indexes have been committed
3108 // commit for Master file data must be done now
3109 //
3110 wSt = _Base::_insert2Phases_Commit(pRecord->RawContent,wZMFIdxCommit,wZMFAddress);// accept insert update on Master File
3111 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3112 {
3113 _add_HardRollbackIndexes (IndexRankProcessed); // indexes are already committed so use hardRollback to counter pass
3114 } // don't care about the status . In case of error exception stack will trace it
3115
3116
3117 if (getJournalingStatus())
3118 {
3119 ZJCB->Journal->enqueue(ZJOP_Insert,pRecord->RawContent);
3120 }
3121
3122_insertRaw_error:
3123 // _Base::_unlockFile () ; // set Master file unlocked
3124 IndexItemList.clear();
3125 return wSt;
3126}// _insertRaw
3127#endif // __OLD_VERSION__

3169ZStatus
3170ZRawMasterFile::_addRaw(ZDataBuffer& pRecord, ZArray<ZDataBuffer> &pKeysContent)
3171{
3172 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
3173
3174 zrank_type wZMFZBATRank ;
3175 zaddress_type wZMFAddress;
3176
3177 ZIndexItemList IndexItemList; // stores keys description per index processed
3178
3179 ZIndexItem *wIndexItem=nullptr;
3180 zrank_type wIndex_Rank;
3181
3182 if (pKeysContent.size() != IndexTable.count()) {
3183 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::zaddRaw",
3184 ZS_CORRUPTED,
3185 Severity_Severe,
3186 "Master file number of indexes <%ld> does not correspond to given keys <%ld>. File <%s> cannot be accessed.\n"
3187 "Record source definition must be outdated or invalid.\n"
3188 "Align <.h> header file with file structure.",
3189 IndexTable.count(),pKeysContent.size() ,
3190 getURIContent().toString());
3191 return ZS_CORRUPTED;
3192 }
3193
3194 if (!isOpen())
3195 {
3196 ZException.setMessage("ZRawMasterFile::zaddRaw",
3197 ZS_FILENOTOPEN,
3198 Severity_Severe,
3199 " File <%s> is not open while trying to access it",
3200 getURIContent().toString());
3201 return ZS_FILENOTOPEN;
3202 }
3203
3204// prepare the add on Master File, reserve appropriate space, get entry in pool, lock it
3205
3206
3207 wSt=_Base::_add2Phases_Prepare( pRecord, wZMFZBATRank, // get internal ZBAT pool allocated rank
3208 wZMFAddress); // get also zmf record address
3209 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3210 {
3211 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(wZMFZBATRank);
3212 goto zaddRaw_end;
3213 }
3214
3215 // =========== update all defined Indexes ======================
3216
3217
3218 for (wIndex_Rank=0;wIndex_Rank< IndexTable.size();wIndex_Rank++)
3219 {
3220 if (BaseParameters->VerboseFileEngine())
3221 _DBGPRINT( "ZRawMasterFile::_addRaw processing key rank <%ld>\n",wIndex_Rank)
3222
3223
3224 wSt=IndexTable[wIndex_Rank]->_addRawKeyValue_Prepare(wIndexItem,pKeysContent[wIndex_Rank], wZMFAddress);
3225 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3226 {
3227 ZException.addToLast(" During _addRawKeyValue_Prepare operation on key rank <%ld>",wIndex_Rank);
3228 delete wIndexItem;
3229 // on error Soft rollback all already processed indexes in their original state (IndexRankProcessed heap contains the Index ranks added to Indexes that have been processed)
3230 _rollbackIndexes ( IndexItemList); // An additional error during index rollback will pushed on exception stack
3231 // on error reset ZMF in its original state
3232 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(wZMFZBATRank); // do not accept update on Master File and free resources
3233 goto zaddRaw_end;
3234 }
3235
3236 IndexItemList.push(wIndexItem); // with that key content
3237
3238 // ZMFJournaling.push (ZO_Add,wi,pRecord,wAddress);
3239
3240 }// main for - IndexTableObjects.size()
3241
3242 // so far everything when well
3243 // commit Indexes changes
3244 // if an error occurs during index commit :
3245 // indexes are rolled back (soft or hard) appropriately within _add_CommitIndexes
3246 // Nb: Exception(s) is(are) pushed on stack
3247
3248 wSt=_commitIndexes (IndexItemList) ;
3249 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3250 {
3251 _rollbackIndexes ( IndexItemList); // An additional error during index rollback will pushed on exception stack
3252
3253 // Soft rollback master update regardless returned ZStatus
3254 // Nb: Exception is pushed on stack. ZException keeps the last status.
3255 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(wZMFZBATRank);
3256
3257 goto zaddRaw_end;
3258 }
3259 // at this stage all indexes have been committed
3260 // commit for Master file data must be done now
3261 //
3262 wSt = _Base::_add2Phases_Commit(pRecord,wZMFZBATRank,wZMFAddress);// accept update on Master File
3263
3264// Then: if then an error occurs at this stage : hard rollback all indexes since begin till processed index
3265 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3266 _rollbackIndexes ( IndexItemList); // An additional error during index rollback will pushed on exception stack
3267 } // we don't care about the status . In case of error exception stack will trace it
3268
3269 if ((wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) && getJournalingStatus())
3270 {
3271// IndexItemList._exportAppend(wEffectiveRecord);
3272 ZJCB->Journal->enqueue(ZJOP_Add,pRecord);
3273 }
3274zaddRaw_end:
3275// _Base::_unlockFile () ; // set Master file unlocked
3276 return wSt;
3277
3278}// _addRaw

3563ZStatus
3564ZRawMasterFile::_insertRawOld (const ZDataBuffer& pRecord, ZArray<ZDataBuffer>& pKeys, const zrank_type pZMFRank)
3565{
3566 ZDataBuffer wEffectiveRecord;
3567 ZStatus wSt;
3568
3569 // zrank_type wZMFIdxCommit;
3570 zaddress_type wZMFAddress=0;
3571
3572 // ZArray <zrank_type> IndexRankProcessed; // stores ranks of already processed indexes (rollback purpose)
3573 ZIndexItemList IndexItemList; // stores keys description per index processed
3574
3575 ZIndexItem* wIndexItem=nullptr;
3576 zrank_type wIndex_Rank;
3577
3578/* Appropriate space ;
3579 uint64_t size of user record
3580
3581 .... record content (pRecord) ....
3582
3583 user record buffer space given by pRecord.Size
3584 uint32_t number of keys
3585 zaddress_type for key 1
3586 zaddress_type for key 2
3587 ...
3588 zaddress_type for key n
3589
3590
3591IMPORTANT : wEffectiveRecord must not be modified until its final setup
3592
3593*/
3594 wEffectiveRecord.setData_T<uint64_t>(uint64_t(pRecord.Size));
3595 wEffectiveRecord.appendData( pRecord);
3596 unsigned char* wPtr=wEffectiveRecord.extend(sizeof(uint32_t)+ (pKeys.count() * sizeof(zaddress_type)));
3597
3598 wSt=_Base::_insert2Phases_Prepare(wEffectiveRecord,pZMFRank,wZMFAddress);
3599 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3600 goto _insertRaw_error;
3601 //
3602 // update all Indexes
3603 //
3604
3605 for (wIndex_Rank=0;wIndex_Rank< IndexTable.size();wIndex_Rank++)
3606 {
3607 wSt=IndexTable[wIndex_Rank]->_addRawKeyValue_Prepare(wIndexItem,pKeys[wIndex_Rank], wZMFAddress);// for indexes don't care about insert, this is an add key value
3608
3609 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3610 {
3611 ZException.addToLast("During zinsert operation on index number <%ld>",wIndex_Rank);
3612 delete wIndexItem;
3613 // on error Soft rollback all already processed indexes in their original state (IndexRankProcessed heap contains the Index ranks added to Indexes that have been processed)
3614 _rollbackIndexes ( IndexItemList); // An additional error during index rollback will pushed on exception stack
3615 // on error reset ZMF in its original state
3616 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(pZMFRank); // do not accept update on Master File and free resources
3617 goto _insertRaw_error;
3618 }
3619
3620 // IndexRankProcessed.push(wIndex_Rank) ; // this index has been added to this rank
3621 IndexItemList.push(wIndexItem); // with that key content
3622
3623 // ZMFJournaling.push (ZO_Add,wi,pRecord,wAddress);
3624 }// main for
3625
3626 // so far everything when well
3627 // commit Indexes changes
3628 // if an error occurs during index commit :
3629 // indexes are rolled back (soft or hard) appropriately within _add_CommitIndexes
3630 // Nb: Exception(s) is(are) pushed on stack
3631 wSt=_commitIndexes (IndexItemList) ;
3632 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3633 {
3634 // Soft rollback master update regardless returned ZStatus
3635 // Nb: Exception is pushed on stack. ZException keeps the last status.
3636 _Base::_add2Phases_Rollback(pZMFRank);
3637 _rollbackIndexes ( IndexItemList);
3638 goto _insertRaw_error;
3639 }
3640
3641 // at this stage all indexes have been committed
3642 //
3643 /* Before committing Raw Master File (writting record)
3644 set all index record addresses to ZMF record
3645 */
3646 _exportAtomicPtr<uint32_t>(pKeys.count() , wPtr);
3647
3648 for (long wi = 0; wi < pKeys.count() ; wi++)
3649 _exportAtomicPtr<zaddress_type>(IndexItemList[wi]->IndexAddress , wPtr);
3650
3651
3652 wSt = _Base::_insert2Phases_Commit(pRecord,pZMFRank,wZMFAddress);// accept insert update on Master File
3653 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3654 {
3655 _rollbackIndexes (IndexItemList); // indexes are already committed so use hardRollback to counter pass
3656 // nb: roll back routine manages soft and hard rollback
3657 } // don't care about the status . In case of error exception stack will trace it
3658
3659
3660 if (getJournalingStatus())
3661 {
3662 IndexItemList._exportAppend(wEffectiveRecord);
3663 ZJCB->Journal->enqueue(ZJOP_Insert,wEffectiveRecord);
3664 }
3665
3666_insertRaw_error:
3667 // _Base::_unlockFile () ; // set Master file unlocked
3668 IndexItemList.clear();
3669 return wSt;
3670}// _insertRawOld

3689ZStatus
3690ZRawMasterFile::_removeByRankR (ZDataBuffer &pRecord, const zrank_type pZMFRank)
3691{
3692 ZStatus wSt;
3693 ZArray<zaddress_type> wIndexAddresses;
3694 ZIndexItemList IndexItemList; // stores keys description per index processed (rollback purpose). Must stay as pointer (double free)
3695 ZIndexItem *wIndexItem;
3696 ZDataBuffer wKeyContent;
3697 zaddress_type wZMFAddress;
3698
3699 ZDataBuffer wEffectiveRecord;
3700 ZArray<ZDataBuffer> wKeys;
3701
3702 //---- get Master File header test for lock - if OK lock it
3703
3704 wSt=_Base::_removeR_Prepare(wEffectiveRecord,pZMFRank,wZMFAddress); // prepare remove on Master File mark entry in pool as to be deleted
3705 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3706 {
3707 _Base::_remove_Rollback(pZMFRank);
3708 return wSt;
3709 }
3710
3711 /* extract record data : user record content - list of corresponding index record addresses*/
3712 uint64_t wUserContentSize;
3713
3714 const unsigned char* wPtr = wEffectiveRecord.Data;
3715
3716 _importAtomic<uint64_t>(wUserContentSize,wPtr);
3717
3718 /* point to index addresses block */
3719 wPtr += size_t(wUserContentSize);
3720 uint32_t wIndexCount;
3721
3722 _importAtomic<uint32_t>(wIndexCount,wPtr);
3723
3724 /* import all adresses */
3725 zaddress_type wIdxAd;
3726 for (uint32_t wi=0 ; wi < wIndexCount ; wi++) {
3727 _importAtomic<zaddress_type>(wIdxAd,wPtr);
3728 wIndexAddresses.push(wIdxAd);
3729 }
3730 //
3731 // update all Indexes
3732 //
3733
3734 IndexItemList.clear();
3735 long wi;
3736 long wIdxRank;
3737 // must extract keys value per key to remove each index key one by one
3738 // pRawRecord->getContentFromRaw(pRawRecord->Content,pRawRecord->RawContent);
3739
3740 for (wi=0;wi< wKeys.count();wi++) {
3741
3742 wIndexItem = new ZIndexItem;
3743 wIndexItem->setBuffer(wKeys[wi]);
3744 wIndexItem->ZMFAddress = wZMFAddress;
3745 wIndexItem->IndexAddress = wIndexAddresses[wi];
3746
3747 wSt=IndexTable[wi]->_removeRByAddress_Prepare(wKeyContent,wIdxRank , wIndexAddresses[wi]);
3748
3749// wSt=IndexTable[wi]->_removeIndexItem_Prepare(wIndexItem , wi);
3750 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3751 {
3752 // delete wIndexItem; // free memory for errored key value
3753 // on error reset all already processed indexes in their original state
3754 // (IndexRankProcessed heap contains the Index ranks added)
3755 // An additional error during index rollback will be put on exception stack
3756
3757 _rollbackIndexes ( IndexItemList); // do not care about ZStatus : exception will be on stack
3758
3759 // on error reset ZMF in its original state
3760 _Base::_remove_Rollback(pZMFRank); // do not accept update on Master File and free resources
3761
3762 // if (HistoryOn)
3763 // ZMFHistory.push (ZO_Add,wi,wAddress,wSt); //! journalize Error on index if journaling is enabled
3764
3765 // _Base::_unlockFile (ZDescriptor) ; // unlock done in remove rollback
3766
3767 goto _removeByRank_return ; // and send appropriate status
3768 }
3769
3770 wIndexItem->fromFileKey(wKeyContent);
3771 wIndexItem->IndexRank = wIdxRank;
3772 IndexItemList.push(wIndexItem);
3773
3774 // ZMFJournaling.push (ZO_Add,wi,pRecord,wAddress);
3775 }// main for
3776
3777 // so far everything when well
3778 // commit changes
3779
3780 wSt=_commitIndexes (IndexItemList) ;
3781 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3782 {
3783 // in case of error : appropriate indexes soft or hard rollback is made in Commit Indexes routine
3784
3785 _Base::_remove_Rollback(pZMFRank); // an error occurred on indexes : rollback all MasterFile
3786 // _Base::_unlockFile (ZDescriptor) ; // unlock is done in rollback routine
3787 goto _removeByRank_return ;// if an error occurs here : this is a severe error that only may be caused by an HW or IO subsystem failure.
3788 }
3789
3790 wSt = _Base::_remove_Commit(pZMFRank);// accept update on Master File
3791 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) // and if then an error occur : rollback all indexes and signal exception
3792 {
3793 _rollbackIndexes (IndexItemList); // indexes are already committed so use hardRollback to counter pass
3794 goto _removeByRank_return ;
3795 }
3796
3797 if ((wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) && getJournalingStatus()) {
3798 IndexItemList._exportAppend(wEffectiveRecord);
3799 ZJCB->Journal->enqueue(ZJOP_RemoveByRank,wEffectiveRecord);
3800 }
3801
3802_removeByRank_return :
3803 // _Base::_unlockFile () ;
3804
3805 IndexItemList.clear();
3806 return wSt;
3807}// _removeByRankRaw

3840ZStatus
3841ZRawMasterFile::_rollbackIndexes ( ZArray <ZIndexItem*> &pIndexItemList)
3842{

3846
3847
3848 for (wi=0;wi < pIndexItemList.size();wi++)

3851 IndexTable[wi]->_rawKeyValue_HardRollback(pIndexItemList[wi]);

3853 IndexTable[wi]->_rawKeyValue_Rollback(pIndexItemList[wi]); // rollback add on each index concerned
3854 }//for // don't care about ZStatus: exception stack will track

3935ZStatus
3936ZRawMasterFile::_remove_CommitIndexes (ZIndexItemList & pIndexItemList, ZArray<zrank_type> &pIndexRankProcessed)
3937{
3938ZStatus wSt;
3939long wj = 0;
3940
3941// ZException.getLastStatus() =ZS_SUCCESS;
3942 for (wj=0;wj<pIndexRankProcessed.size();wj++)
3943 {
3944 wSt=IndexTable[wj]->_rawKeyValue_Commit(pIndexItemList[wj]);
3945 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3946 {
3947// hard roll back already processed indexes
3948// and soft rollback not yet processed indexes
3949// wj = errored index rank : up to wj : hardRollback - from wj included to pIndexTableObjects.size() soft rollback
3950
3951 for (long wR=0;wR < wj;wR++) // Hard rollback for already committed indexes
3952 {
3953 IndexTable[wR]->_rawKeyValue_HardRollback(pIndexItemList[wR] ,pIndexRankProcessed[wR]); // rollback update on each index concerned
3954 // regardless ZStatus (exception is on stack)
3955 } // for
3956
3957 for (long wR = wj;wR<pIndexRankProcessed.size();wR++) // soft rollback
3958 {
3959 IndexTable[wR]->_rawKeyValue_Rollback(pIndexItemList[wR] ,pIndexRankProcessed[wR]); // rollback update on each index concerned
3960 // regardless ZStatus (exception is on stack)
3961 }// for
3962
3963 return ZException.getLastStatus(); // return the very last status encountered
3964 }//wSt
3965 } // Main for
3966
3967 return ZException.getLastStatus();
3968} // _remove_CommitIndexes

3972ZRawMasterFile::_remove_RollbackIndexes (ZArray<ZIndexItem*> &pIndexItemList,ZArray<zrank_type> &pIndexRankProcessed)

3974
3975
3976ZStatus wSt;
3977long wi = 0;
3978
3979
3980// ZException.getLastStatus() = ZS_SUCCESS;

3982 fprintf(stderr,"_remove_RollbackIndexes Soft Rollback of indexes on remove\n");
3983
3984 for (wi=0;wi < pIndexRankProcessed.size();wi++)
3985 {
3986 IndexTable[wi]->_rawKeyValue_Rollback(pIndexItemList[wi],pIndexRankProcessed[wi]); // rollback remove on each index concerned
3987 }// for // don't care about ZStatus: exception stack will track
3988
3989 return ZException.getLastStatus();
3990} // _remove_RollbackIndexes

3994ZRawMasterFile::_remove_HardRollbackIndexes (ZArray<ZIndexItem*> &pIndexItemList,

4352ZStatus ZRawMasterFile::XmlExportOneRecord(__FILEHANDLE__ pFd,

4366 return wSt;
4367
4368 if (pBlockHeader!=nullptr) {
4369 wStr.sprintf("Block info : state %s size %ld lock %s pid %d",
4370 decode_ZBS(pBlockHeader->State),
4371 pBlockHeader->BlockSize,
4372 decode_ZLockMask(pBlockHeader->Lock),
4373 pBlockHeader->Pid);
4374 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd,fmtXMLcomment(wStr,pLevel),wSizeWritten);
4375 }
4376
4377 wSt=URFParser::rawParse(pRecord,wFieldList,pErrorLog);
4378 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4379 return wSt;
4380
4381 for (int wi=0; wi < wFieldList.count();wi++) {
4382 if (pBlockHeader!=nullptr) {
4383 const char* wHoleNature=nullptr;
4384 wCurrentOffset = wFieldList[wi].FieldPtr - pRecord.Data;
4385 wStr.sprintf("rank %d record offset %ld size %ld",wi,wCurrentOffset,wFieldList[wi].Size);
4386 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd,fmtXMLcomment(wStr,pLevel+1),wSizeWritten);
4387 if (wi == 0) {
4388 if (wCurrentOffset!=0) {
4389 if (wCurrentOffset < 0) {
4390 wStr.sprintf ("MAJOR ERROR : Field offset is %ld bytes before record boundary.",
4391 -wCurrentOffset);
4392 }
4393 else {
4394 wStr.sprintf ("Hole found in beginning of file with %ld bytes : reserved to Presence bit set.",
4395 wCurrentOffset);
4396 }
4397 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd,fmtXMLcomment(wStr,pLevel+1),wSizeWritten);
4398 }
4399 }
4400 else {
4401 wHoleValue = wFieldList[wi].FieldPtr - (wFieldList[wi-1].FieldPtr + wFieldList[wi-1].Size) ;
4402 if (wHoleValue!=0) {
4403 wStr.sprintf ("Hole found with %ld bytes",
4404 wHoleValue);
4405 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd,fmtXMLcomment(wStr,pLevel+1),wSizeWritten);
4406 }
4407 }//else
4408 } // block header exists
4409
4410 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd,fmtXMLnode("field",pLevel+1),wSizeWritten);
4411 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4412 return wSt;
4413
4414 if (pMetaDic!=nullptr) {
4415 if (wi < pMetaDic->count()) {
4416 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd, fmtXMLchar("name",pMetaDic->TabConst(wi).getName(),pLevel+2),wSizeWritten);
4417
4418 if (wFieldList[wi].ZType != pMetaDic->Tab(wi).ZType) {
4419 wStr.sprintf(" ***Warning*** dictionary field ZType <%s> does not match with file ZType <%s>",
4420 decode_ZType(pMetaDic->TabConst(wi).ZType),
4421 decode_ZType(wFieldList[wi].ZType ));
4422 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd, fmtXMLcomment(wStr,pLevel+2),wSizeWritten);
4423 }
4424 }
4425 else {
4426 wStr.sprintf("Field of rank %d is not in meta dictionary",wi);
4427 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd, fmtXMLcomment(wStr,pLevel+2),wSizeWritten);
4428 }
4429 }
4430
4431
4432
4433 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd,wFieldList[wi].toXml(pLevel+2),wSizeWritten);
4434 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4435 return wSt;
4436
4437 wSt=rawWriteText(pFd,fmtXMLendnode("field",pLevel+1),wSizeWritten);
4438 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4439 return wSt;
4440
4441 }// for
4442 return rawWriteText(pFd,fmtXMLendnode("record",pLevel),wSizeWritten);
4443} // XmlExportOneRecord
4444ZStatus ZRawMasterFile::XmlExportContent(const uriString &pXmlContentFile,ZaiErrors *pErrorLog)
4445{
4446 ZArray<URFField> wFieldList;
4447 bool wHasBeenOpened=false;
4448 long wRank=0;
4449 __FILEHANDLE__ wFd=__FILEHANDLEINVALID__;
4450 utf8VaryingString wXmlString ;
4451 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
4452 ZDataBuffer wZDB;
4453
4454 if (!isOpen()) {
4455 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4456 pErrorLog->errorLog("Master file <%s> must be open with at least mode ZRB_ALL for importing data with XmlExportContent.",getURIContent().toString());
4457 return ZS_FILENOTOPEN;
4458 }// isOpen
4459
4460 uriStat wStats;
4461 wSt=URIContent.getStatR(wStats); /* get dates for identification section */
4462 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4463 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4464 pErrorLog->errorLog("Cannot stat master file <%s>.",getURIContent().toString());
4465 return wSt ;
4466 }
4467 if (_progressSetupCallBack!=nullptr)
4468 _progressSetupCallBack(int(getRecordCount()),"Exporting master file content");
4469
4470
4471 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4472 _progressCallBack(wRank,"Exporting identification");
4473
4474 wXmlString=fmtXMLdeclaration();
4475 utf8VaryingString wCom;
4476 wCom.sprintf("This file has been processed by XmlExportContent on %s",ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toDMYhms().toString());
4477 wXmlString += fmtXMLcomment(wCom,0);
4478
4479 wXmlString += fmtXMLnode("zmasterfilecontent",0);
4480 wXmlString += fmtXMLcomment(" identification section is there for audit purposes ",1);
4481 wXmlString += fmtXMLnode("identification",1);
4482 wXmlString += fmtXMLchar("source",getURIContent(),2);
4483 wXmlString += fmtXMLdatefull("creationdate",wStats.Created,2);
4484 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wXmlString," effective data creation date ");
4485 wXmlString += fmtXMLdatefull("modificationdate",wStats.LastModified,2);
4486 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wXmlString," effective data last modification date ");
4487 wXmlString += fmtXMLendnode("identification",1);
4488
4489 wSt=rawOpenCreate( wFd,pXmlContentFile.toCChar());
4490 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4491 if (wHasBeenOpened)
4492 zclose();
4493 return wSt;
4494 }
4495 size_t wSizeWritten=0;
4496 wSt=rawWriteText(wFd,wXmlString,wSizeWritten);
4497 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4498 goto ErrorExportContent;
4499 }
4500
4501 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4502 _progressCallBack(wRank,"Exporting file records");
4503
4504 if (Dictionary!=nullptr) {
4505 utf8VaryingString wStr;
4506 wStr.sprintf(" A Dictionary named <%s> has been defined for this file.\n",Dictionary->DicName.toString());
4507 wSt=rawWriteText(wFd,fmtXMLcomment(wStr.toCChar(),1),wSizeWritten);
4508 }
4509 else
4510 wSt=rawWriteText(wFd,fmtXMLcomment(" No Dictionary has been defined for this file ",1),wSizeWritten);
4511
4512 wSt=zget(wZDB,wRank);
4513 while (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) {
4514
4515 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4516 _progressCallBack(wRank,utf8VaryingString()); /* with null string */
4517
4518// sleepTimes(1);
4519 wSt=XmlExportOneRecord(wFd,wZDB,1,nullptr,Dictionary,pErrorLog);
4520
4521
4522 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4523 return wSt;
4524 wSt=zget(wZDB,++wRank);
4525 }// while ZS_SUCCESS
4526
4527 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4528 if (wSt==ZS_OUTBOUNDHIGH)
4529 wSt=ZS_EOF;
4530 else
4531 goto ErrorExportContent;
4532 }
4533 wSt=rawWriteText(wFd,fmtXMLendnode("zmasterfilecontent",0),wSizeWritten);
4534
4535
4536
4537 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4538 _progressCallBack(wRank,"End process");
4539EndExportContent :
4540 rawClose(wFd);
4541 if (wHasBeenOpened)
4542 zclose();
4543 return wSt;
4544ErrorExportContent :
4545 if (wSt==ZS_EOF) {
4546 wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
4547 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4548 _progressCallBack(wRank,"End process");
4549 goto EndExportContent;
4550 }
4551 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4552 _progressCallBack(wRank,"Errored process");
4553 goto EndExportContent;
4554
4555} //exportContent

4558ZRawMasterFile::XmlExportContentFromSurfaceScan(const uriString& pURIContentFile,
4559 const uriString& pXmlContentFile,
4560 __progressCallBack__(_progressCallBack),
4561 __progressSetupCallBack__(_progressSetupCallBack),
4562 ZaiErrors* pErrorLog)
4563{
4564 ZArray<URFField> wFieldList;
4565 ZBlockDescriptor wBlockDescriptor;
4566 ZDataBuffer wRecord;
4567 size_t wProgress=0;
4568 size_t wSizeWritten=0;
4569 int wBlockCount=0;
4570 size_t wTotalBlockSize=0, wTotalUserSize=0,wUserSize , wTotalFreeSize=0 , wTotalDeletedSize=0 ;
4571 zaddress_type wCurrentAddress=0, wNextAddress=0,wPhysicalSize=0;
4572
4573 __FILEHANDLE__ wFdXml=__FILEHANDLEINVALID__,wFdContent=__FILEHANDLEINVALID__;
4574
4575 utf8VaryingString wXmlString ;
4576 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
4577
4578 uriStat wStats;
4579 wSt=pURIContentFile.getStatR(wStats); /* get dates for identification section */
4580 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4581 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4582 pErrorLog->errorLog("Cannot stat master file <%s>.",pURIContentFile.toString());
4583 return wSt ;
4584 }
4585
4586 wSt = rawOpenRead(wFdContent,pURIContentFile);
4587 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4588 return wSt ;
4589 }
4590
4591 wSt = rawOpenCreate(wFdXml,pXmlContentFile);
4592 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4593
4594 return wSt ;
4595 }
4596
4597 if (_progressSetupCallBack!=nullptr)
4598 _progressSetupCallBack(int(wStats.Size),"Read byte size");
4599
4600 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4601 _progressCallBack(0,"Exporting identification");
4602
4603 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4604 pErrorLog->textLog("Exporting identification");
4605
4606
4607 wXmlString=fmtXMLdeclaration();
4608
4609 utf8VaryingString wCom;
4610 wCom.sprintf("This file has been processed by XmlExportContentFromSurfaceScan on %s",ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toDMYhms().toString());
4611 wXmlString += fmtXMLcomment(wCom,0);
4612
4613
4614 wXmlString += fmtXMLnode("zmasterfilecontent",0);
4615 wXmlString += fmtXMLcomment(" identification section is there for audit purposes ",1);
4616 wXmlString += fmtXMLnode("identification",1);
4617 wXmlString += fmtXMLchar("source",pURIContentFile,2);
4618 wXmlString += fmtXMLdatefull("creationdate",wStats.Created,2);
4619 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wXmlString," effective data creation date ");
4620 wXmlString += fmtXMLdatefull("modificationdate",wStats.LastModified,2);
4621 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wXmlString," effective data last modification date ");
4622 wXmlString += fmtXMLendnode("identification",1);
4623
4624 wSt=rawWriteText(wFdXml,wXmlString,wSizeWritten);
4625 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4626 goto ErrorExportContentFSS;
4627 }
4628
4629 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4630 pErrorLog->textLog("Exporting identification done");
4631
4632 wProgress=100;
4633 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4634 _progressCallBack(wProgress,utf8VaryingString());
4635
4636
4637 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4638 _progressCallBack(wProgress,"Exporting file records");
4639
4640 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4641 pErrorLog->textLog("Exporting file records");
4642
4643 wSt=rawSearchNextStartSign(wFdContent,wStats.Size,-1,wCurrentAddress,wCurrentAddress);
4644 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4645 goto ErrorExportContentFSS;
4646
4647 /* search next block to test block size validity */
4648 wSt=rawSearchNextStartSign(wFdContent,wStats.Size,-1,wCurrentAddress+sizeof(cst_ZFILEBLOCKSTART),wNextAddress);
4649 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) { /* ZS_READPARTIAL is not returned : considered as valid access if startsign is found */
4650 if (wSt==ZS_EOF)
4651 wNextAddress = wStats.Size;
4652 else
4653 goto ErrorExportContentFSS;
4654 }
4655
4656 while (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) {
4657 wProgress = wCurrentAddress ;
4658 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4659 _progressCallBack(wProgress,utf8VaryingString()); /* with null string */
4660
4661 wSt=rawGetBlockDescriptor(wFdContent,wBlockDescriptor,wCurrentAddress);
4662 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4663 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4664 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast("ZRawMasterFile::XmlExportContentFromSurfaceScan");
4665 goto ErrorExportContentFSS;
4666 }
4667 wPhysicalSize = wNextAddress-wCurrentAddress;
4668 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr) {
4669 pErrorLog->textLog("Getting #%d size %ld state %s lock %s pid %d address %ld next %ld physical size %ld %s",
4670 ++wBlockCount,wBlockDescriptor.BlockSize,decode_ZBS(wBlockDescriptor.State),
4671 decode_ZLockMask(wBlockDescriptor.Lock).toString(),wBlockDescriptor.Pid,
4672 wCurrentAddress,wNextAddress,wPhysicalSize, wBlockDescriptor.BlockSize <= wPhysicalSize?"Size is OK":"Invalid block size");
4673 }
4674
4675 wTotalBlockSize += wBlockDescriptor.BlockSize;
4676 if (wBlockDescriptor.State==ZBS_Free)
4677 wTotalFreeSize += wBlockDescriptor.BlockSize ;
4678 else if (wBlockDescriptor.State==ZBS_Deleted)
4679 wTotalDeletedSize += wBlockDescriptor.BlockSize ;
4680 else
4681 wTotalUserSize += wUserSize = wBlockDescriptor.BlockSize - sizeof(ZBlockDescriptor_Export);
4682 wBlockCount++;
4683
4684 wSt=rawRead(wFdContent,wRecord,wUserSize);
4685 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4686 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)
4687 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast("ZRawMasterFile::XmlExportContentFromSurfaceScan");
4688 goto ErrorExportContentFSS;
4689 }
4690// sleepTimes(1);
4691 wSt=XmlExportOneRecord (wFdXml,wRecord,1,&wBlockDescriptor,nullptr,pErrorLog);
4692 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
4693 goto ErrorExportContentFSS;
4694 }
4695 wCurrentAddress = wNextAddress;
4696 wSt=rawSearchNextStartSign(wFdContent,wStats.Size,-1,wCurrentAddress + sizeof(cst_ZFILEBLOCKSTART) ,wNextAddress);
4697 } // while
4698
4699 wSt=rawWriteText(wFdXml,fmtXMLendnode("zmasterfilecontent",0),wSizeWritten);
4700
4701 wProgress = wCurrentAddress ;
4702
4703 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4704 _progressCallBack(wProgress,"End process");
4705
4706EndExportContentFSS:
4707
4708 pErrorLog->textLog("___________Export from surface scan Report___________\n"
4709 "Overall file size %ld\n"
4710 "Total block volume read %ld\n"
4711 "User volume %ld\n"
4712 "Free volume %ld\n"
4713 "Deleted volume %ld\n"
4714 "Number of blocks found %ld\n"
4715 "Mean used block size %ld\n"
4716 "Last address %ld\n"
4717 "Overall content space usage (1) %g %\n"
4718 "Used content space usage (2) %g %\n"
4719 "Free space vs used size (3) %g %\n"
4720 // "Available space vs used size (4) %g %\n"
4721 "(1) Percentage of user used space vs total file size.\n"
4722 "(2) Percentage of user used space vs total of used blocks size.\n"
4723 "(3) Percentage of free space vs total of used blocks size.\n"
4724 "(4) Percentage of free and deleted space vs total of used blocks size.\n",
4725 wStats.Size,
4726 wTotalBlockSize,
4727 wTotalUserSize,
4728 wTotalFreeSize,
4729 wTotalDeletedSize,
4730 wBlockCount,
4731 wTotalUserSize / wBlockCount,
4732 wCurrentAddress,
4733 double(wTotalUserSize) * 100.0 / double(wStats.Size),
4734 double(wTotalUserSize) * 100.0 / double(wTotalBlockSize),
4735 double(wTotalFreeSize+wTotalDeletedSize) * 100.0 / double(wTotalUserSize)
4736 );
4737
4738
4739 rawClose(wFdContent);
4740 rawClose(wFdXml);
4741 return wSt;
4742ErrorExportContentFSS:
4743 if (wSt==ZS_EOF) {
4744 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4745 _progressCallBack(wProgress,"End process");
4746 goto EndExportContentFSS;
4747 }
4748 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast("XmlExportContentFromSurfaceScan");
4749 pErrorLog->errorLog("Export from surface scan stopped at address %ld",wCurrentAddress);
4750 goto EndExportContentFSS;
4751} //XmlExportContentFromSurfaceScan

4778 // zxmlElement *wRoot = nullptr;

4780 ZDataBuffer wRecordToWrite;
4781// bool wHasBeenOpened=false;

4785 utf8VaryingString wXmlString , wXmlComment;
4786 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;

4788 ZDataBuffer wZDB;
4789 if (!isOpen()) {

4792 else

4797 wOpenMode = getOpenMode();

4801 else
4802 fprintf(stderr,"Master file <%s> must be open with mode ZRB_ALL for importing data using XmlImportContentByChunk.\n",getURIContent().toCChar());
4803 }
4804
4805

4814 "Cannot open xml output file <%s> mode ZRF_All status is <%s>\n",
4815 pXmlContentFile.toCChar(),
4816 decode_ZStatus(wSt));
4817
4818 // zclose();
4819 return wSt;
4820 }
4821 { // specific code segment to delete local variables later on

4825 wMsg="No option";
4826 break;
4827 }
4828 if (pOption & ZEXOP_CheckName) {
4829 wMsg="Check Names";
4830 }

4833 break;
4834 }
4835 break;
4836 } // while true
4837 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr)

4839 wMsg.toString());
4840 else
4841 fprintf(stdout,"Importing options <%s>\n",
4842 wMsg.toCChar());
4843
4844 if (Dictionary==nullptr) {

4849 }
4850 } // end code segment
4851
4852 if (_progressSetupCallBack!=nullptr)

4854
4855 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4856 _progressCallBack(0,"Importing identification");
4857
4858 /* identification part */
4859
4860 wSt=XMLLoadEntity(wFd,"identification",wXmlRecordContent,wOffset);
4861 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)

4863
4864 wSt = XmlImportIdentification(wXmlRecordContent,wIdentification,pErrorLog);

4871
4872 _progressCallBack(wOffset,"identification imported");

4874
4875 wSt=XMLLoadEntity(wFd,"record",wXmlRecordContent,wOffset);
4876 if ((wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)&&(wSt!=ZS_EOF))
4877 goto XmlImportContentByChunkErrored ;
4878
4879
4880 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4881 _progressCallBack(wOffset,"Importing file records");
4882
4883
4884 while ((wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) || (wSt==ZS_EOF))
4885 {
4886 wRecordsRead++;
4887// sleepTimes(1);
4888 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)

4890
4891 // below is already done by XMLLoadEntity

4893// wXmlFullRecordContent += wXmlRecordContent ;
4894 wSt=wXmlRecord.writeContent(wXmlRecordContent); /* just to debug-view content */
4895 wRecordsWritten++;

4897 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4898 goto XmlImportContentByChunkErrored ;
4899
4900 wSt = _addRawDisregardKeys(wRecordToWrite);
4901 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4902 goto XmlImportContentByChunkErrored ;
4903 if (wEof)
4904 break;
4905 wSt=XMLLoadEntity(wFd,"record",wXmlRecordContent,wOffset);

4907 wEof=true;
4908 }// while
4909 if (wSt!=ZS_EOF)
4910 goto XmlImportContentByChunkErrored ;
4911
4912XmlImportContentByChunkEnd:
4913 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4914 _progressCallBack(wStats.Size,utf8VaryingString());
4915 /* if (wOpenMode==0)
4916 zclose();
4917*/
4918XmlImportContentByChunkEnd_1:
4919 rawClose(wFd);
4920
4921 pErrorLog->textLog("Record import report\n"
4922 "Imported data creation date %s\n"
4923 " Last modified %s\n"
4924 "records from Xml %d\n"
4925 "records written to file %d\n",
4926 wIdentification.CreationDate.toDMYhms().toString(),
4927 wIdentification.ModificationDate.toDMYhms().toString(),
4928 wRecordsRead,wRecordsWritten);
4929
4930 if (wSt==ZS_EOF)
4931 wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
4932 return wSt;
4933XmlImportContentByChunkErrored:
4934 if (wSt==ZS_EOF) {
4935 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4936 _progressCallBack(wRank,"End process");
4937 goto XmlImportContentByChunkEnd_1;
4938 }
4939 if (_progressCallBack!=nullptr)
4940 _progressCallBack(wRank,"Processing errored");
4941 pErrorLog->errorLog("Importing record process is errored and interrupted.");
4942 goto XmlImportContentByChunkEnd_1;
4943} // XmlImportContentByChunk

4963 pXmlRecordContent.subString(0, 25).toString());
4964 }
4965 else
4966 fprintf(stderr,"XmlImportIdentification-E-PARSERR Xml parsing error for string <%s>",
4967 pXmlRecordContent.subString(0, 25).toString());
4968 return wSt;
4969 }
4970*/
4971 wSt=wDoc->getRootElement(wRecordRoot);
4972 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
4973 return wSt;
4974
4975 if (wRecordRoot->getName()!="identification") {
4976 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr) {
4977 pErrorLog->errorLog(
4978 "XmlImportIdentification-E-INVROOT Invalid Xml root node <%s> while expecting <identification>" , wRecordRoot->getName());
4979 }
4980 else
4981 fprintf(stderr,"XmlImportIdentification-E-INVROOT Invalid Xml root node <%s> while expecting <identification>",wRecordRoot->getName());
4982
4983 return ZS_XMLINVNODENAME;
4984 } // == zrecord
4985
4986 wSt=XMLgetChildZDateFull(wRecordRoot,"creationdate",pIdentification.CreationDate,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
4987
4988 wSt=XMLgetChildZDateFull(wRecordRoot,"modificationdate",pIdentification.ModificationDate,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
4989
4990 XMLderegister(wRecordRoot);
4991 XMLderegister(wDoc);
4992 return wSt;
4993}

4996
4997ZStatus
4998ZRawMasterFile::XmlImportRecordContent(const utf8VaryingString& pXmlRecordContent, ZDataBuffer& pRecord, ZEXOP_Type pOption,ZaiErrors *pErrorLog)
4999{
5000 zxmlDoc *wDoc = nullptr;
5001 zxmlElement *wRecordRoot = nullptr;
5002 zxmlElement *wFieldElt=nullptr;
5003
5004 pRecord.clear();
5005
5006 wDoc = new zxmlDoc;
5007
5008 ZStatus wSt=wDoc->XmlParseFromMemory(pXmlRecordContent,pErrorLog);
5009 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
5010 return wSt;
5011 wSt=wDoc->getRootElement(wRecordRoot);
5012
5013 if (wRecordRoot->getName()!="record") {
5014 if (pErrorLog!=nullptr) {
5015 pErrorLog->errorLog(
5016 "XmlImportRecordContent-E-INVROOT Invalid Xml root node <%s> while expecting <record>" , wRecordRoot->getName());
5017 }
5018 else
5019 fprintf(stderr,"XmlImportRecordContent-E-INVROOT Invalid Xml root node <%s> while expecting <record>",wRecordRoot->getName());
5020
5021 return ZS_XMLINVNODENAME;
5022 } // == zrecord
5023
5024
5025 ZArray<URFField> wFieldList;
5026 URFField wField;
5027
5028 zxmlNode* wFieldNode=nullptr;
5029 ZDataBuffer wRecordZDB;
5030 ZDataBuffer wFieldZDB;
5031
5032 int wCount=0;
5033 wSt=wRecordRoot->getFirstChild(wFieldNode);
5034
5035 if (pErrorLog==nullptr)
5036 pErrorLog = &ErrorLog;
5037
5038 while (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) {
5039 /* get one field */
5040 wSt = wField.fromXml((zxmlElement*)wFieldNode, wFieldZDB,pErrorLog);
5041 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
5042 return wSt;
5043
5044 /* dictionary integrity check */
5045
5046 if (Dictionary != nullptr) {
5047 if (pOption & ZEXOP_CheckName) {
5048 if (!wField.Name.isEmpty()) {
5049 if (wField.Name != Dictionary->Tab(wCount).getName()) {
5050 pErrorLog->errorLog("ZRawMasterFile::XmlImportRecordContent-E-INVNAM Read field name <%s> does not match dictionary name <%s>",
5051 wField.Name.toString(),
5052 Dictionary->Tab(wCount).getName().toString());
5053 }
5054 }
5055 else
5056 pErrorLog->warningLog("ZRawMasterFile::XmlImportRecordContent-E-EMPTYNAM Read file name is empty and cannot be compared to dictionary name <%s>",
5057 Dictionary->Tab(wCount).getName().toString());
5058 } //ZEXOP_CheckName
5059
5060 if (pOption & ZEXOP_CheckZType) {
5061 if (Dictionary->Tab(wCount).ZType != wField.ZType) {
5062 pErrorLog->errorLog("ZRawMasterFile::XmlImportRecordContent-E-INVTYP Read field ZType <%X %s> does not match dictionary ZType <%X %s>",
5063 wField.ZType, decode_ZType(wField.ZType),
5064 Dictionary->Tab(wCount).ZType,decode_ZType(Dictionary->Tab(wCount).ZType) );
5065 }
5066 }// ZEXOP_CheckZType
5067 } // Dictionary != nullptr)
5068
5069 wCount++ ;
5070 wRecordZDB.appendData(wFieldZDB);
5071 wFieldList.push(wField);
5072
5073 XMLderegister(wFieldNode);
5074 wSt=wRecordRoot->getNextNode(wFieldNode);
5075 } // while
5076 /* Define field presence : a field is present if at least ZType node has been defined for this field */
5077
5078 ZBitset wPresence(uint16_t(wFieldList.count()));
5079 wPresence.clear();
5080 for (int wi=0; wi < wFieldList.count();wi++) {
5081 if (wFieldList[wi].Present)
5082 wPresence.set(wi);
5083 }
5084
5085 /* final formatting of URF record with leading presence bitset */
5086 wPresence._exportURF(pRecord);
5087 pRecord.appendData(wRecordZDB);
5088
5089 XMLderegister(wRecordRoot);
5090 XMLderegister(wDoc);
5091 return ZS_SUCCESS;
5092} // XmlImportRecordContent

5366ZStatus ZRawMasterFile::_copyTo(const uriString& pNewContentURI,
5367 uint8_t pFlag,
5368 int pPayLoad, /* if -1 then defaulted to rawCopyPayLoad see setRawCopyPayLoad() (zioutils.h)*/
5369 ZaiErrors* pErrorLog)
5370{
5371 ZStatus wSt = ZS_SUCCESS;
5372 if (!(getOpenMode()& ZRF_Read_Only)) {
5373 if (isOpen())
5374 zclose();
5375 wSt=zopen(ZRF_Read_Only);
5376 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
5377 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast("ZRawMasterFile::getCopySize");
5378 return wSt;
5379 }
5380 } // ZRF_Read_Only
5381
5382 if (pFlag & ZMNP_IncludeAll) {
5383 for (int wi=0; (wi < IndexTable.count()) && (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS);wi++) {
5384 uriString wIndexURI;
5385 __progressCallBack__(wPCB) = IndexTable[wi]->_progressCallBack;
5386 __progressSetupCallBack__(wPSUCB) = IndexTable[wi]->_progressSetupCallBack;
5387 IndexTable[wi]->registerProgressCallBack(_progressCallBack);
5388 IndexTable[wi]->registerProgressSetupCallBack(_progressSetupCallBack);
5389 wSt=generateIndexURI(wIndexURI,pNewContentURI,uriString(),IndexTable[wi]->IndexName);
5390 if (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS)
5391 wSt=IndexTable[wi]->_copyTo(wIndexURI,pFlag,pPayLoad,pErrorLog);
5392 IndexTable[wi]->_progressCallBack=wPCB;
5393 IndexTable[wi]->_progressSetupCallBack=wPSUCB;
5394 }// for
5395 } // ZMNP_IncludeAll
5396 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
5397 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast("ZRawMasterFile::_copyTo");
5398 return wSt;
5399 }
5400
5401 wSt=ZRandomFile::_copyTo(pNewContentURI,pFlag,pPayLoad,pErrorLog);
5402 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
5403 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast("ZRawMasterFile::_copyTo");
5404 return wSt;
5405 }
5406 zclose();
5407 return wSt;
5408} // ZRawMasterFile::_copyTo

5410ZStatus ZRawMasterFile::getCopySize( size_t &pSize,uint8_t pFlag, ZaiErrors *pErrorLog)
